Title: RTX 20-Series Vs. GTX 10-Series | ZOTAC
URL: https://www.zotac.com/news/rtx-20-series-vs-gtx-10-series
Published: 2018-09-13T16:52:04.000Z
Author: N/A
Highlights:
The ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 2080 AMP Model

The next step up from the ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 2080 Blower model is the ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 2080 AMP. With nearly 400 cores more than our 1080 AMP! model, this performance powerhouse will overshadow your old card. Memory clock speeds have increased from 10GHz to now being capable of 14.0 Gbps (video memory upgraded from GDDR5 to GDDR6) and with new SLI NVLINK support, your gaming experience will hit extreme performance when coupled with another RTX 2080 AMP.

...

The ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 2080 Ti AMP Model

As our cards get more powerful, the gap between the previous generation widens. If you currently own our more powerful, flagship ZOTAC GeForce GTX 1080 Ti AMP! and are looking to upgrade, the ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 2080 Ti AMP! is an evolution even further beyond the RTX 2080 AMP variant. The 2080 Ti AMP has nearly 800 more CUDA cores than the 1080 Ti AMP! And provides upgraded memory (GDDR6), memory clock speed, and of course, USB Type-C. More importantly, we’ve upped our cooling game. Instead of 2 x 100mm fans, the new 2080 Ti AMP comes with three 90mm fans, all powered by individual fan control technology known as Active Fan Control (AFC, just like the RTX 2080 AMP) and with our sleek new fan design that improves airflow (also like the RTX 2080 AMP). With all this new power, it’s only going to cost you 50 watts more, with a recommended power supply of 650W compared to the 1080 Ti’s recommended 600W.
